description: This file defines the TransactionalStateOptions class, which contains configuration options related to transactional state management, including timeouts and limits for locks, prepare phases, and retries.

classes.name: TransactionalStateOptions
classes.description: A class encapsulating configuration options for transactional state, such as timeouts and limits.

methods.name: DefaultLockTimeout
methods.description: Default timeout duration for lock occupation.

methods.name: DefaultPrepareTimeout
methods.description: Default timeout duration for the prepare phase.

methods.name: DefaultLockAcquireTimeout
methods.description: Default timeout duration for acquiring a lock.

methods.name: DefaultRemoteTransactionPingFrequency
methods.description: Default frequency for remote transaction pings.

methods.name: DefaultMaxLockGroupSize
methods.description: Default maximum size for lock groups.
